title: IBPS SO XVI Online Form 2026 (1035 Posts) – Last Date Today

shortDescription: IBPS SO XVI Online Form 2026 for revised 1035 Specialist Officer posts. Last date 26 July 2026 (extended).
content:
IBPS CRP SPL-XVI Specialist Officer recruitment is open for 1,035 posts (revised from 745 on 20 July 2026).

Approx. stream mix: IT Officer, Agricultural Field Officer, Law Officer, Rajbhasha Adhikari, HR/Personnel, Marketing Officer.

Apply online: 1–26 July 2026 at ibps.in.
